title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: OpenAI DevDay: Agents API gets computer use, MCP Events spec, and GPT-6.1 Sol at ~1/5 the price of GPT-6 Astra
bullets.summary: DevDay shipped an Agents API with computer use, multi-agent, tool search and context compaction, plus MCP Events support for ChatGPT plugins, Codex cloud environments, and GPT-6.1 Sol with cached input at $0.10/M tokens.
bullets.how: The Construct: track the MCP Events spec for event-driven triggers instead of pure cron, and benchmark cheaper model tiers for high-volume routines. PRAGMA: GUI-operating agents lower the cost of client operator builds for legacy software with no API.

bullets.title: Anthropic launches $100M Claude Frontier Academy to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by end of 2027
bullets.summary: Anthropic is funding an enterprise talent program with cohorts in San Francisco, New York and London, aimed at the forward-deployed AI engineer role.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: validates the AI-operator consulting category and the FDE role; position PRAGMA as the ready-now alternative while enterprise FDE supply is still ramping. Watch for partner/certification openings.

bullets.title: Google unveils Gemini 4 Argon; CNBC asks whether Google can catch OpenAI and Anthropic at the frontier
bullets.summary: Google's new frontier model landed the same week as Sonnet 5.5 (Sep 28) and GPT-6.1 Sol; I could only confirm the headline, not benchmark details (article was blocked).
bullets.how: The Construct: add Gemini 4 Argon to the model-routing bake-off for long-context and multimodal tasks once pricing and benchmarks are published. Brand 9 Signs: re-test image/vision tasks such as sign-mockup review.

praxis_lesson: Three frontier model families shipped in one week (Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol, Gemini 4 Argon) while prices fell about 5x, so model choice is now a routing decision, not a loyalty decision. Keep a per-task eval harness so Construct jobs can switch models in hours, not weeks.
